landing.badge: AI Retail Intelligence & Local Stock Recovery
landing.heroTitle: Predict Expiry Risk. Protect Margin. Zero Stock Waste.
landing.heroSubtitle: The first AI-driven retail platform designed specifically for neighbourhood grocery stores in India. It predicts unsold stock in rupees, recommends price-floor protected discounts, and lets nearby customers reserve them before expiry.
landing.featuresTitle: Built from the Ground Up for Indian Retailers
landing.featuresSubtitle: Existing billing software only records past sales. RetailIQ predicts the future and takes action.
landing.feature1Desc: First-Expired, First-Out batch deduction keeps track of manufacture and expiry dates with zero stock discrepancy.
landing.feature2Desc: Know exact financial risk days ahead. Shows projected leftover quantity and estimated loss in rupees.
landing.feature3Desc: Never sells below purchase price. AI grid-searches the smallest discount that clears slow-moving stock.
landing.feature4Desc: Hyperlocal marketplace where neighbourhood shoppers discover near-expiry discounts and collect in-store.
landing.feature5Desc: Full native experience in English, Kannada, and Hindi with regional terminology for shopkeepers.
landing.feature6Desc: Ask questions about top sellers or expiring stock with strict guardrails preventing hallucinated numbers.
landing.howItWorksTitle: How It Works in 3 Simple Steps
landing.step1Desc: Scan barcodes or type simple sentences like '5 packets Parle-G at 5 rupees'. Batches and shelf life are instantly recorded.
landing.step2Desc: Machine learning forecasts sales demand and projects remaining stock before batch expiry with early warning alerts.
landing.step3Desc: Generate WhatsApp campaign packs and list items on the local rescue marketplace for customer reservation.
landing.rolesSubtitle: RetailIQ bridges store owners and neighbourhood shoppers.
landing.roleShopkeeperDesc: Take full control of batches, expiry alerts, smart discounts, customer orders, and AI demand forecasting.
landing.roleCustomerDesc: Find fresh, heavily discounted daily essentials from reputable neighbourhood shops and pick them up directly.
landing.footerTagline: Smarter stock. Less waste. Higher profits.
landing.rights: All rights reserved. Built for Indian Neighbourhood Retailers.
